newsitem.title: INDIA: India castor down, speculators square up positions.
newsitem.headline: India castor down, speculators square up positions.

text.p: Indian castorseed March delivery prices on Tuesday fell to 1,110 rupees from 1,120/1,122 rupees on fresh speculative selling as speculators squared up positions, dealers said.
"The delivery period for March contract is around the corner and speculators were busy squaring up outstanding positions," one dealer said.
June delivery moved up to 1,208/1,210 rupees per quintal from 1,195/1,196 rupees.
Sentiment remained firm on reports that Indian exporters had finalised export deals for 10,000/12,000 tonnes of castorseed at the rate of 340/345 dollars per tonne.
"Fresh export enquiries for castoroil also aided the firm sentiments," the dealer said.
Groundnut oil was steady at 344/345 rupees per 10 kg amid limited arrivals of 50/60 tonnes while demand was dull.
Imported palm oil was steady at 281/282 rupees per 10 kg.
Rajkot spot groundnut oil remained steady at 518/520 rupees per 15 kg.
